brief:
International isolation of Israel has shifted from a temporary reaction to the war in Gaza into a strategic crisis affecting its global image and diplomatic future, Shehab Wire reported. The isolation now extends beyond Prime Minister Netanyahu and his government to Israel's broader political structure.

The growing diplomatic estrangement threatens Israel's long-term international relationships and poses challenges that transcend immediate political leadership, according to the account.

title: Israel faces deepening international isolation after October 7
